summary: Iteration 134 - Bug Fixes Testing Complete. All 3 reported bugs verified as fixed: (1) Admin 'Alle abmelden' button now uses AlertDialog (mobile-safe) with proper data-testids, (2) WebRTC video call fix verified - mediaReady gate + signal queue implemented in LiveMeetingPage.js to prevent race condition where WS signals arrived before getUserMedia resolved, (3) Chat notification wiring moved to ChatUnreadContext.js for global toast+sound on any page. Backend: 10/10 tests passed. Frontend: All UI elements verified.

bug_1_force_logout_all_alertdialog.details: AlertDialog opens with data-testid='force-logout-all-dialog', confirm button data-testid='force-logout-all-confirm', cancel button data-testid='force-logout-all-cancel'. POST /api/admin/force-logout-all returns {modified_count: N}.

bug_2_webrtc_video_fix.details: LiveMeetingPage.js has mediaReady state (line 90), mediaReadyRef (line 91), pendingSignalsRef (line 92). Guard at lines 335-339 queues signals if !mediaReadyRef.current. Replay useEffect at lines 510-519 processes queue when mediaReady becomes true. Live meeting page loads correctly with local video tile.

bug_3_chat_notification_global.details: ChatUnreadContext.js imports playNotificationSound (line 4) and toast (line 5). mutedConvsRef populated from /chat/unread-summary (lines 42-49). new-message handler plays sound + shows toast for non-own, non-muted, non-dnd messages (lines 86-106). ChatPage.js removed playNotificationSound call (lines 164-169 comment confirms move).

smoke_test_digital_signage_preview.details: GET /api/news/digital-signage/preview/{post_id} requires auth (returns 401/403 without), returns post data with preview=true flag when authenticated.

backend_api_tests.details: 10/10 pytest tests passed: force-logout-all endpoint, auth requirements, chat unread-summary, chat my-status, meeting CRUD, admin users list, admin stats.

frontend_ui_tests.details: Admin page loads, Users tab accessible, Force Logout All button opens AlertDialog, Live meeting page loads with local video tile and meeting controls.

critical_code_review_comments: WebRTC fix is well-documented with comments explaining the race condition (iter 134 comments in LiveMeetingPage.js)
ChatUnreadContext notification logic properly handles DND, muted conversations, and active conversation exclusion
